newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits fall to 2,880.3 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits fall to 2,880.3 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits fell by 222.3 million Swiss francs to 2.88 billion in the reporting period ended April 18.
Statement of April 21 in millions of Swiss francs:

Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window fell by 20.7 million francs to 3.5 million in the reporting period. Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates fell by 717.9 million francs to 446.1 million.
An SNB spokesman said the level of sight deposits was rather low and this was due to a sharp drop in demand for liquidity last Friday.
"We've had an unusually high level of liquidity in the system," the spokesman said.
But the drop was mostly technical, he added.

Friday was the last day of the monthly liquidity calculation period. Banks having ample liquidity to meet the monthly requirement were probably reluctant to take on any additional liquidity, the SNB spokesman also said.
